purchase_lines_reception_range.name: purchase_lines_reception_range
purchase_lines_reception_range.value: ("purchase_lines"."good_quantity" is null and "purchase_lines"."damaged_quantity" is null) or ("purchase_lines"."good_quantity" >= 0 and "purchase_lines"."damaged_quantity" >= 0 and "purchase_lines"."good_quantity" + "purchase_lines"."damaged_quantity" <= "purchase_lines"."quantity")

purchases_reception_consistent.name: purchases_reception_consistent
purchases_reception_consistent.value: ("purchases"."status" = 'Recibido' and "purchases"."received_at" is not null and "purchases"."received_by" is not null) or ("purchases"."status" <> 'Recibido' and "purchases"."received_at" is null and "purchases"."received_by" is null)

supplier_pendings_sign.name: supplier_pendings_sign
supplier_pendings_sign.value: ("supplier_pendings"."type" in ('damaged', 'missing', 'reopened') and "supplier_pendings"."quantity" > 0 and "supplier_pendings"."value_cents" >= 0) or ("supplier_pendings"."type" in ('replaced', 'written_off', 'discounted', 'returned') and "supplier_pendings"."quantity" < 0 and "supplier_pendings"."value_cents" <= 0)

supplier_pendings_origin.name: supplier_pendings_origin
supplier_pendings_origin.value: ("supplier_pendings"."type" in ('damaged', 'missing') and "supplier_pendings"."settles_id" is null) or ("supplier_pendings"."type" not in ('damaged', 'missing') and "supplier_pendings"."settles_id" is not null)

supplier_pendings_resolution.name: supplier_pendings_resolution
supplier_pendings_resolution.value: ("supplier_pendings"."type" = 'returned' and "supplier_pendings"."resolution" is not null and ("supplier_pendings"."resolution" = 'discount' or "supplier_pendings"."credit_cents" is null) and ("supplier_pendings"."credit_cents" is null or "supplier_pendings"."credit_cents" >= 0)) or ("supplier_pendings"."type" <> 'returned' and "supplier_pendings"."resolution" is null and "supplier_pendings"."credit_cents" is null)

customer_rules_one_kind.name: customer_rules_one_kind
customer_rules_one_kind.value: ("customer_commercial_rules"."discount_bps" is not null) <> ("customer_commercial_rules"."price_cents" is not null)

cash_movements_sign.name: cash_movements_sign
cash_movements_sign.value: ("cash_movements"."type" = 'withdrawal' and "cash_movements"."amount_cents" < 0) or ("cash_movements"."type" = 'rider_difference' and "cash_movements"."amount_cents" <> 0) or ("cash_movements"."type" not in ('withdrawal', 'rider_difference') and "cash_movements"."amount_cents" > 0)

rider_allocations_settlement_range.name: rider_allocations_settlement_range
rider_allocations_settlement_range.value: ("rider_allocations"."leftover_quantity" is null and "rider_allocations"."sold_quantity" is null) or ("rider_allocations"."leftover_quantity" >= 0 and "rider_allocations"."sold_quantity" >= 0 and "rider_allocations"."leftover_quantity" + "rider_allocations"."sold_quantity" = "rider_allocations"."quantity")

rider_assignments_closing_consistent.name: rider_assignments_closing_consistent
rider_assignments_closing_consistent.value: ("rider_assignments"."status" = 'En ruta') = ("rider_assignments"."closed_at" is null and "rider_assignments"."closed_by" is null)

rider_assignments_settlement_consistent.name: rider_assignments_settlement_consistent
rider_assignments_settlement_consistent.value: ("rider_assignments"."status" = 'Liquidada') = ("rider_assignments"."expected_cents" is not null and "rider_assignments"."delivered_cents" is not null and "rider_assignments"."difference_cents" is not null)

rider_assignments_amounts_min.name: rider_assignments_amounts_min
rider_assignments_amounts_min.value: ("rider_assignments"."expected_cents" is null or "rider_assignments"."expected_cents" >= 0) and ("rider_assignments"."delivered_cents" is null or "rider_assignments"."delivered_cents" >= 0)
